findings.summary: The runner validates only the 40-hex shape of reviewed_commit and never proves that it resolves to the reviewed deployed revision; a synthetic test accepts an arbitrary valid-looking commit.
Hashed project helper modules are imported before their digests are verified, so substituted import-time code could execute before mismatch refusal.
The release consumer checks artifact presence and receipt digest but not CONSUMED content, RELEASED contract binding, receipt schema, or the allowed output field set.

passed_checks: contract job freeze split registry and toolchain digests matched the reviewed tree
source-set preregistration and post-consumption comparison were implemented
output paths were fixed and isolated
MISSING_RESULT_PATH remained in the R07 denominator
HF/HMF action keys excluded F and outcome fields
aggregate-only success and failure receipts and replay refusal were implemented
fourteen focused synthetic v5 tests passed
required_disposition: Preserve v5 as failed review evidence. Remediate under v6 with a minimal externally integrity-checked bootstrap that validates the exact reviewed commit and every project module before importing them, plus semantic release verification.
